claims.text: The driver's GPS trace is impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07, not merely tagged so by the pre-pass: it carries a single gap of 428.0 seconds between consecutive fixes, far over the clause's own 90-second limb (a), and coverage of 81.7% sits under the 90.0 threshold. I disclose the impairment as POL-GEN-02(1) requires: the artifact is rated IMPAIRED at weight_multiplier 0.39 on issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and the pre-pass records that the dropout is over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so it is impaired for policy and not merely for admissibility.

The dropout sits squarely over the segment the rider disputes. It is bounded by the Defu Flyover portal fix and the Kallang portal fix, 6.90 km apart in a straight line, and the artifact's own issue detail states that the gap covers the entire segment the rider disputes. The distance evidence is therefore missing exactly where the disputed kilometres lie.

The only figure in the bundle that puts this trip under the POL-RD-01 gate is the reading most favourable to the driver, and it exists only because the data is missing. On 21.20 km the excess over the 18.4 km optimal is 2.8 km, 15.2%, which fails the 20% percentage limb (3.68 km). But 21.20 km is the straight-line-across-the-gap measurement POL-RD-07(i) prescribes precisely because the trace is impaired, and the pre-pass records that a surface route between the same two portals puts the trip at 25.50 km and well over. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings, so the threshold test has no reliable input.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), POL-RD-07(ii) bars establishing a deviation on the gps_trace alone: corroboration must come from an independent source, which the clause defines exhaustively as a driver admission in the chat log, ERP gantry lines placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a counterparty statement admitting the route, or a trip-record distance derived independently of this trace.

No chat corroboration exists. The log carries two messages only - the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok' - and contains no driver admission; the pre-pass says so expressly. It is also truncated, ending at 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended at 19:02:40, so whatever was said for the rest of the journey is absent from the export. I disclose the impairment: EV-CHAT-00110 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.6 on issue code TRUNCATED_LOG. The driver's message names the KPE, which is the optimal corridor itself ('KPE then ECP'), not a corridor the optimal route avoids.

The fare ledger cannot carry the point either. Its erp_gantries field is null, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, and distance_charged_km of 21.20 is identical to the impaired trace figure - a copy, not an independent measurement, as its own notes state. I disclose the impairment: EV-FARE-00110 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.75 on issue code PARTIAL_RECORD.

The trip record is not the independent source POL-RD-07(ii) invites. Its actual_distance_km of 21.2 is itself derived from the impaired trace, as its own admissibility note concedes, so it adds no independent evidence of distance - and POL-RD-01 expressly says the trip-record figure may not be cited for the threshold test.

The driver offers no exculpatory artifact at all. His answer, that his phone loses signal in the tunnel, is an explanation of the dropout, not a POL-RD-03 traffic advisory; no advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window, and EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 cannot be run on this record and the assertion discharges no burden under POL-RD-08. The driver points to no artifact and no clause beyond the impaired trace.

Nor can the driver say the rider asked for the detour. The rider's 'ok' answers the driver's route message; it identifies no place or road to act on, and the chat message's waypoint_hint is null, so the POL-RD-04 corroboration test cannot be run and the clause is unavailable on this record. The rider never instructed the driver to leave the optimal corridor.

The consequence is escalation, not defeat. POL-RD-10(3) requires the judge to ESCALATE where the gps_trace is impaired under POL-RD-07 and no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists. POL-RD-07(iii) is explicit that the outcome there is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, because the absence of proof is a data failure and not a finding for the driver. NO_ACTION would instead leave the full charge standing on a measurement the policy itself calls the reading most favourable to the driver.

The confidence cap points the same way independently. The deciding fact - how far the car actually travelled - is carried by the trace alone at weight 0.39; the trip record merely copies that figure and the fare ledger is not independent, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cannot exceed 0.39, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, which trips POL-RD-10(1) as well.

The rider's own side of POL-RD-08(a) is satisfied so far as the record allows: trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-00110, and the trace's first fix at 18:23:40 sits inside the trip record's own window, so the artifacts describe the same trip. What cannot be done is limb (b), measuring an excess from an unimpaired source or from a POL-RD-07(ii) independent source, because no such source exists in this bundle.

The rider is not a serial claimer and no extra corroboration burden attaches. POL-RD-08's additional requirement engages only where rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 4 or more; the rider's is 1, with 0 substantiated, so the factor is not engaged and the claim may not be discounted on profile. Under POL-GEN-01 the rider's rating, account age and lifetime counters are context only and decide nothing.

claims.text: No deviation is established: the POL-RD-01 gate is not cleared. The governing distance is the trace, and the trace is IMPAIRED — weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE — which I disclose at the outset. Measured the way POL-RD-07(i) prescribes as the reading most favourable to the driver, the straight line between the bounding fixes across the 428 s dropout, the trip is 21.20 km against a booked optimal of 18.4 km — an excess of 2.8 km, or 15.22% of optimal. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal AND 0.8 km. The percentage limb fails, so no route deviation exists and the outcome is NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip, billing integrity under POL-RD-09(4) being the only carve-out and being absent here.

The trip record offers the rider no second, unimpaired measurement. Its actual_distance_km of 21.2 is, by the admissibility note, itself derived from the same impaired trace and so adds no independent evidence of distance; POL-RD-01 in any event makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km govern where it disagrees with trip_record.actual_distance_km, and forbids citing the rounded convenience copy for the threshold test. The trace relied on is impaired: EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is not discharged. He must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired gps_trace, or from an independent source of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names. He has neither: the only trace is impaired (EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE); the fare ledger merely repeats the trace figure (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD); the trip record's distance is a copy of the trace; and no gantry record places the vehicle off the optimal corridor. The rider's own account adds nothing, by his own admission he was not watching the route.

The billed distance is not the independent corroboration POL-RD-07(ii) demands. The fare breakdown's distance_charged_km of 21.20 is identical to the trace figure, and POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes a billed distance that is a copy of the trace from the list of independent sources. Both artifacts are impaired and I disclose both: the fare breakdown at weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD (erp_gantries null against a non-zero toll); the trace at weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. The ledger corroborates neither a longer route nor an off-corridor gantry.

The contemporaneous record is consistent with the optimal corridor, not a detour. The driver messaged the rider 'going KPE ah boss' before entering the tunnel and the rider replied 'ok'; the KPE is exactly the corridor the platform's own route uses, the trip record recording the optimal as KPE then ECP and crossing both gantries. The chat log is IMPAIRED — weight 0.6, issue TRUNCATED_LOG — which I disclose; what survives is nonetheless the only contemporaneous account of the route, and it sits with the pro-driver tunnel reading rather than with a surface detour.

The rider's $3.00 ERP objection yields no billing-integrity refund. The fare breakdown carries no erp_gantry lines at all, so no gantry can be shown to be one the trace never passes; the optimal route's own ERP is 3.00 and the ledger's tolls_erp is 3.00, so the line matches the platform's own estimate rather than a phantom charge. The ledger is IMPAIRED — weight 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD — which I disclose. POL-RD-09(4) requires an unmatched line before anything is refunded, and where a gantry carries no coordinates the line is treated as matched.

Even if some deviation were found, it is not MATERIAL and no repeat-pattern uplift could attach. At 15.22% the excess is far below POL-RD-01's 50% materiality limb and below its 8.0 km limb, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged. For completeness the citable counters show no pattern in any event: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so neither POL-RD-06 limb is met and no FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral can follow. The trace (EV-GPS-00110) is impaired at weight 0.39, issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, which I disclose.

No traffic advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the trip window, and the driver needs none. EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING and carries weight 0.0, so the absence is itself citable; no party has cited an advisory, and the driver advances no closure or external cause for a detour — he explains the tunnel dropout, not a diversion. With no advisory on file there is no external event that could have pushed the vehicle off the optimal corridor, and POL-RD-03 exoneration is unavailable to either side; an uncited traffic excuse carries no weight under POL-RD-13. The trace is impaired (EV-GPS-00110, weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE), which I disclose.

On no view of this record does the rider recover the $10.00 he seeks. NO_ACTION is party-relative under POL-GEN-03: with the rider as filer, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0, NO_ACTION leaves the present charge standing, which is the driver's position. If the impaired trace is instead treated as precluding a final finding, the deciding distance fact is carried solely by EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at 0.39, below the 0.70 floor, and POL-RD-07(iii) together with POL-RD-10(3) makes the terminal outcome ESCALATE — which holds the disputed amount rather than collecting or refunding it. Either disposition leaves the driver's fare intact and returns nothing to the rider. The trace and the fare ledger are both impaired and I disclose them: EV-GPS-00110 weight 0.39, GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; EV-FARE-00110 weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case cannot be finally decided on the record, so it goes to a human reviewer and the disputed $10.00 — and the charge behind it — is held rather than collected or refunded.

What is common ground. You were charged $34.42 (EV-FARE-00110) for a Sengkang–Marina Bay trip priced against an optimal route of 18.4 km / 26 minutes (EV-TRIP-00110). The driver's device traced 21.2 km over 39 minutes (EV-GPS-00110).

The defect. EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428-second dropout between the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes — more than four times POL-RD-07's 90-second limb — directly over the segment the rider disputes, with 81.7% coverage. It is rated weight 0.39 on issues GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE. Because the dropout is over POL-RD-07's own 90-second limb, the trace is impaired for policy as well as for admissibility. This finding survives the discount because it is a defect of the artifact itself, confirmed by the pre-pass.

What follows. Under POL-RD-07, where the trace is impaired a deviation may not be established on the trace alone; it needs an independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, ERP gantry lines placing the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use, a counterparty statement admitting the route, or a trip-record distance derived independently of this trace. None exists. The chat log (EV-CHAT-00110, weight 0.6, TRUNCATED_LOG) contains only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok' — no admission, and the KPE is the optimal corridor itself. The fare ledger's 21.20 km is a copy of the trace figure and it carries no gantry lines (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, PARTIAL_RECORD). The trip record's 21.2 km is itself derived from the impaired trace (EV-TRIP-00110), so it is not independent. The driver's counterparty statement — that he took the KPE — describes the optimal corridor, so it is not an admission of a detour.

Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c) and no independent corroboration exists, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) require ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION: the absence of proof is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. The same conclusion follows independently from POL-RD-10(1): the deciding fact — how far the car actually travelled — is carried by EV-GPS-00110 alone, so under POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cannot exceed 0.39, below the 0.70 floor.

The competing arguments. The driver's case that the straight-line reading (2.8 km, 15.2%, below the POL-RD-01 20% limb) ends in NO_ACTION is rejected as a final outcome: that reading is still a reading of the broken trace, and the record itself notes that a surface route between the same portals would put the trip at 25.5 km and well over the gate, with nothing in the bundle distinguishing the two. For the same reason the rider's position that a deviation is simply established cannot succeed without corroboration. The rider's profile does not raise an extra corroboration burden — deviation_claims_60d is 1, below POL-RD-08's threshold of 4 — and the other profile fields are context only under POL-GEN-01. No POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral arises: the excess is not material (15.2% and 2.8 km are below the 50% / 8.0 km limbs) and the citable counters show no pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 of 744). No billing-integrity referral arises: the $3.00 ERP matches the platform's own optimal-route estimate of $3.00 and the ledger itemises no gantry, so no line is shown to be one the trace never passes. No POL-RD-03 exoneration is available: EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0 and no advisory covers the trip window.

Referrals: none — ESCALATE is terminal and no clause produces a referral on these facts. This differs from precedents P-0001 and P-0002, where the distance evidence was not an impaired trace lacking independent corroboration. To close this case a reviewer needs an independent distance or gantry record for the disputed segment.
